prompt: Passing a non-string plugin name (fp(fn, { name: 123 })) crashes with an unhelpful 'name.replace is not a function'. Validate it like the fastify version option: throw a TypeError naming what was received.
requirement: When options.name is present (not undefined) and not a string, plugin() throws a TypeError with message `fastify-plugin expects a name string, instead got '<typeof name>'` (null reports 'object'). A missing or empty name keeps the automatic naming; string names are unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: fp(fn, { name: 123 }) throws TypeError "fastify-plugin expects a name string, instead got 'number'"
objects, booleans and null are rejected the same way
no name or name '' still auto-names the plugin

adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit; behaviour outside the requirement is not graded.
